mock_data.title: A Change of Plan
mock_data.passage:
3/6/02

Dear Stan,

I'm sorry. My plans to come and visit you next weekend have gone pear-shaped. I was really looking forward to seeing you and to having some fun in the big city. Life here can get boring with so many of my friends away at college.

Unfortunately, two things have happened to make me change my plans. We're really under the cosh at work just now. It's coming up to the end of the tax year and, like all accountants, we're up to our ears. To try and cope with the workload the boss has asked us if we could all work overtime this weekend. As usual, I'm on my uppers and could really use the extra cash. Also, I'd like to keep the boss out if I can. He's a decent bloke and has always played very fair with me. It would be difficult to refuse to work when everyone else is going to.

Then, there's a problem with my grandfather. He's not getting any younger and he's been a bit under the weather recently. Mum was worried about him and so he's come to visit for a while to tell. My mother doesn't like leaving him alone in the house and she's agreed to babysit for my sister on Saturday night. Dad's away at a conference that weekend and so it's down to me.

So there it is. What with one thing and another, this weekend is not possible and it would be best from my point of view to leave coming up until some other weekend. Looking on the bright side, I can see that the delay will mean I have more money to spend when I do finally get there, thanks to the overtime.

I hope all is well with you. Drop me a note and let me know if there's any weekend that's not suitable for me to come up, or if there's any weekend that's specially suitable. I would give you the news from home, but there isn't any—or, if there is, I'm working so hard that I haven't heard about it!

Sorry again about the change of plan. I hope it hasn't messed up any of your arrangements. I'll think of you living it up in the bright lights while I'm watching the telly with granddad!

Cheers
Jeff

mock_data.passageC1:
3/6/02

Dear Stan,

Please accept my apologies; my planned visit next weekend has unfortunately gone awry. I was genuinely anticipating catching up with you and enjoying the vibrant atmosphere of the city. Life here has become rather monotonous, particularly with so many friends away pursuing their studies.

Regrettably, a confluence of factors has necessitated this change of plan. Firstly, we are currently under immense pressure at work. As the tax year-end approaches, we are, as is typical for accountants, inundated with work. In an attempt to mitigate the workload, our manager has requested that we all work overtime this weekend. Given my current precarious financial situation, the additional income would be a welcome boost. Furthermore, I feel a sense of obligation to support our manager. He has consistently treated me fairly, and it would be difficult to decline when the rest of the team is contributing.

Secondly, my grandfather's health has become a concern. He is, understandably, feeling the effects of age and has been somewhat out of sorts recently. My mother, understandably worried, has invited him to stay with us for a while for observation and care. She is reluctant to leave him unattended and has agreed to provide childcare for my sister on Saturday evening. With my father attending a conference that weekend, the responsibility falls to me.

Consequently, due to this combination of circumstances, a visit this weekend is simply not feasible. From my perspective, it would be preferable to postpone the trip until a more suitable time. On a more positive note, the delay will allow me to accrue more funds, thanks to the overtime, which I can then enjoy during my visit.

I trust that everything is well with you. Do let me know if there are any weekends that are inconvenient for you, or conversely, particularly convenient. I would share any local news, but frankly, there is either none, or I am so engrossed in my work that I am completely oblivious!

Once again, I apologize for the alteration to our plans. I sincerely hope it hasn't disrupted any prior commitments you may have made. I'll be thinking of you enjoying the city nightlife while I'm keeping my grandfather company in front of the television!

Cheers,

Jeff

questions.answer: Answers will vary. Affected parties might include: friends you were meeting, family members involved, colleagues who were covering for you, venue reservations, travel bookings, other people's schedules that were adjusted to accommodate you, or anyone who had made arrangements dependent on your original plan.

questions.answer: Answers will vary. 3/6/02

Hurmatli Sten,

Kechirasiz. Kelgusi hafta oxirida sizni ziyorat qilish rejalarim barbod bo'ldi. Men sizni ko'rishni va katta shaharda biroz zavqlanishni chin dildan kutgan edim. Bu yerda hayot zerikish mumkin, chunki ko'plab do'stlarim kollejda.

Afsuski, rejalarimni o'zgartirishga majbur qilgan ikki narsa yuz berdi. Biz hozir ishda haqiqatan ham bosim ostidamiz. Soliq yili tugashiga yaqinlashyapti va barcha buxgalterlar kabi, biz juda bandmiz. Ish yukini engish uchun boss bizdan bu hafta oxirida ham ishlashimizni so'radi. Odatdagidek, menda pul kam va qo'shimcha naqd pul haqiqatan ham kerak. Shuningdek, men bossni xursand qilishni xohlayman. U yaxshi odam va doimo menga nisbatan adolatli bo'lgan. Boshqalar ishga kelganida rad etish qiyin bo'lardi.

Keyin, bobom bilan muammo bor. U yoshayib ketmoqda va yaqinda biroz kasal edi. Onam u haqida xavotirlanib, shuning uchun u bir muddat tashrif buyurishdi. Onam uni uyda yolg'iz qoldirishni yoqtirmaydi va u shanba kuni kechqurun singlim uchun bolajonlik qilishga rozi bo'ldi. Dadam o'sha hafta oxirida konferentsiyada va shuning uchun bu mening zimmamdа.

Mana shunday. Bir narsani, ikkinchi narsani hisobga olsak, bu hafta oxiri mumkin emas va mening nuqtai nazarimdan boshqa hafta oxirigacha kelishni qoldirish yaxshiroq bo'ladi. Yaxshi tomondan qarasak, kechikish men u yerga borganimda ko'proq pul sarflashim mumkinligini anglatadi, qo'shimcha ish tufayli.

Umid qilamanki, sizda hammasi yaxshi. Menga xat yozing va agar mening uchun mos bo'lmagan hafta oxiri bo'lsa yoki maxsus mos keladigan hafta oxiri bo'lsa, menga xabar bering. Men sizga uydan yangiliklar berardim, lekin hech qanday yangilik yo'q—yoki agar bor bo'lsa, men juda qattiq ishlayapmanki, bu haqida eshitmadim!

Rejani o'zgartirganim uchun yana kechirasiz. Umid qilamanki, bu sizning rejalaringizni buzmadi. Men sizni yorqin chiroqlar ostida zavqlanayotganingizni tasavvur qilaman, men esa bobom bilan televizor ko'rayapman!

Salomlar
Jeff
